features.title: Browse and edit workspace files
features.summary: Browse bounded project files, open session-scoped Monaco tabs, search and go to line, preserve dirty drafts, and save through Host file APIs.

configuration.constraints: One of workbench or right-panel; applies live.

failureModes: A stale file hash raises a conflict and requires reload or explicit overwrite.
Traversal, symlink, protected metadata, missing parent, and oversized writes are rejected.

externalDependencies.boundary: Host project file list/read/write API over a registered local workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use temporary directories with synthetic files and edits; do not read or write a user repository.

verification.testName: creates a new file without leaving temp siblings
replaces a file whose disk content still matches what the editor loaded, keeping its mode
reports a conflict and leaves the file alone when it changed on disk
overwrites a conflicting file once the user chose to
refuses an absolute path outside the workspace
refuses a symlinked directory that leads outside the workspace
refuses directories, missing parents, oversized content and version-control internals
accepts a root reached through a symlinked prefix

features.title: Index workspace files with bounded traversal
features.summary: Traverse breadth-first with concurrency and entry limits, skipping VCS and dependency directories while surfacing partial results.
failureModes: Unreadable directories are skipped with partial results.
A stale index is refreshed before searching.

verification.testName: lists files breadth-first, skips .git/.jj/node_modules and directories it cannot list
stops at the file cap and reports truncation
answers indexing, then ready, and serves a fresh index without walking again

features.title: Session screen and workspace files for other plugins
features.summary: Provides dshx's SessionScreen contract: the session the main view shows and the one side panels follow, the mounted session's workspace file index (indexing, then ready, kept fresh while followed), one tree level per call, and the Host's file search. The command palette's file search reads its index through it.
failureModes: A directory the Host refuses lists as undefined and a failed search answers no hits, so a caller shows an empty result rather than an error.
The index reports no-session while no session has been shown yet.

verification.testName: indexes the mounted session while followed and moves with it

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the contract reads the native workspaceFiles and fileReferences Remote methods, whose calls carry their own spans.
